name: enterprise-gemini-rag-workstation-langgraph-hybrid-search-hitl
description: An enterprise-grade, multi-format Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) platform powered by Streamlit, LangGraph, and Google Gemini API. This application combines hybrid search (dense vector + sparse BM25), cross-encoder reranking, dynamic document chunking, automated context confidence evaluation, human-in-the-loop (HITL) supervisor overrides, and automatic LLM failover handling.
